rpk: Learners speak the local language daily and built songs, reading, composition and grammar skills through Basic 1-5.
starter: Greet learners; 1-minute 'book talk': teacher shows and names a book from the class collection.
Quick recall: learners mention one thing they read last time.
NEW TODAY: Everyone reads Anansesɛm (folk tale book) quietly.
Set reading rules: eyes on text, quiet lips, note new words.
main: ACTIVITY 1 (Silent reading – 7 min): Learners read Anansesɛm (folk tale book) individually; teacher listens to 2-3 learners read aloud in turn.
ACTIVITY 2 (Pair read – 5 min): Pairs take turns reading short passages aloud to each other; partners help with hard words.
ACTIVITY 3 (Respond to text – 5 min): Learners answer 3 quick questions: 'What was it about? Who was in it? Which part did you like?'
ACTIVITY 4 (Record – 3 min): Learners write the title and one sentence about Anansesɛm (folk tale book) in their reading log in the local language.
plenary: 2-3 learners share their favourite part with the class.
Teacher displays the reading log and praises consistent readers.
Homework: read one page to a family member and retell it.
Encourage learners to borrow a book for the week.
assessment: Class exercises; oral questions; practical performance; SBA
